title: Global PhD Student Fellowship in Computer Science
about: NYU Abu Dhabi's Global PhD Student Fellowship in Computer Science lets NYU PhD students conduct research at NYUAD. Applicants apply to NYU's Computer Science PhD, due 12 December 2026 for Fall 2027, and indicate interest in NYUAD.
requirements: No separate application: apply to the NYU Computer Science PhD and indicate interest in research at NYU Abu Dhabi
Statement of purpose, three letters of recommendation, CV and transcripts
TOEFL or IELTS for applicants whose native language or undergraduate instruction is not English
